description:
Search biosample/tissue ontology or get specific biosample information.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table biosample — one record = one biosample ontology term (tissue, cell type or cell line).
Key: biosampleId.
Arguments: biosample_id accepts biosample (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by match_class asc, then biosampleName asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Biosample terms integrated by OT 25.09 (existence only).

schema.description: Pass at least one of: query, biosample_id. At most one of: query, biosample_id.

biosample_id.description: Accepts biosample; resolved to one biosample (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
